title: Audience to email
t1: Define a segment of the customers you want to reach.
t2: Export the segment's profiles into an email campaign.
t3: Send the personalized email to those customers.

title: Data to segment
t1: Bring your data into Experience Platform from your sources.
t2: Merge the data into a real-time customer profile using the identity graph.
t3: Define a segment over those profiles.

title: Win back churning customers
source: Key use cases - Don't Lose Campaigns
t1: Predict which customers are likely to churn with AI models.
t2: Create an audience of the customers at risk of churning.
t3: Send them a re-engagement offer across the right channels.

title: Re-engage cart abandoners
t1: Identify customers who abandoned their cart.
t2: Create a re-engagement audience from those customers.
t3: Send a personalized re-engagement message in a journey.

title: Web data to destination
t1: Collect website interaction data with the Web SDK.
t2: Create a segment from the collected data.
t3: Activate the audience to a destination.

title: Plan, launch, review
t1: Plan the campaign and check the audience size.
t2: Launch the campaign to the audience.
t3: Review the campaign performance after it goes live.

title: Schema to profile
source: Create schemas / Create and populate a dataset
t1: Create a schema for your data.
t2: Create a dataset and ingest data using that schema.
t3: Enable the dataset for Real-Time Customer Profile.

title: Activate an audience
t1: Create an audience in the platform.
t3: Activate the audience to that destination.

title: Use a playbook
t1: Browse the use case playbook gallery.
t2: Create an instance of a playbook.
t3: Publish the playbook assets to your sandbox.

title: Personalize an offer
source: Key use cases - Lifetime Value / Contextual Recognition
t1: Read the customer's attributes and behavior from their profile.
t2: Pick the best offer for them with Next Best Offer decisioning.
t3: Activate the offer to the customer across any channel.
